title: Result imports
summary: Account for received results and investigate rows that were not applied.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Result imports lists attempts to process received data. Load results file lets you choose a registered instrument and a file. Open an attempt to see its outcome, counts and refusal reasons; file attempts also show file provenance and the template version used.

Quarantined rows need investigation. Set aside lists rows kept outside patient results. Retry import processes the received message again as a new attempt and replaces earlier open quarantine outcomes with the retry’s outcome.

sections.title: Good practice
paragraphs: Reconcile every row category, including duplicates, QC, set-aside rows and measured-but-not-ordered values. A successful file receipt is separate from successful result processing.

Preserve the original export. Correct the source configuration, missing run association or other stated cause before retrying, and record a meaningful reason. Review the new attempt to confirm what changed.

sections.title: If you cannot continue
paragraphs: A changed header, unknown label, unexpected unit or unmapped value can prevent processing. Read the file-level and row-level reasons separately. Repeatedly loading or retrying the same data does not resolve an unchanged cause; inspect the affected source, run or mapping first.

pages.title: Result imports
pages.purpose: Find every recent attempt to process analyzer messages or result files, and load an approved result file manually.
pages.access: Viewing import work requires result-review authority. Load results file additionally requires analysis authority.

fields.name: Processed
fields.meaning: Identifies when an import attempt ran.
fields.values: Recorded date/time; newest attempts first.
fields.rules: Read-only; supplied by the current record.

fields.name: Instrument
fields.meaning: Identifies the source instrument.
fields.values: Configured instrument name.
fields.rules: Read-only; supplied by the current record.

fields.name: Received as
fields.meaning: Distinguishes acquisition paths.
fields.values: Analyzer message, File loaded by hand, File from the watched folder.
fields.rules: Read-only; supplied by the current record.

fields.name: Attempt
fields.meaning: Numbers processing attempts on the same receipt.
fields.values: Positive attempt number; a retry creates a later attempt.
fields.rules: Read-only; supplied by the current record.

fields.name: Outcome
fields.meaning: Summarizes processing, not clinical approval.
fields.values: Processed; Processed, some rows quarantined; Quarantined.
fields.rules: Read-only; supplied by the current record.

fields.name: Rows / Quarantined
fields.meaning: Shows the total rows processed and number held for investigation.
fields.values: Nonnegative counts.
fields.rules: Read-only; open the attempt for all row categories and reasons.

fields.name: Import count / freshness
fields.meaning: Indicates the list’s extent and read time.
fields.values: Count, more-items indication and last refresh.
fields.rules: Loads 200 matching records per page. Use Load older imports to reach retained records beyond the first page; sorting applies to loaded rows. Stable identifier tie-breakers preserve reachability when timestamps match or clocks move backward.

fields.name: Load results file: Instrument
fields.meaning: Chooses the approved source template used to read the file.
fields.values: Instruments with an approved result-file template.
fields.rules: Required; no default. The dialog displays the selected software name/version before choosing the file.

fields.name: File / Size / Received / Import
fields.meaning: Shows the manual-load receipt and eventual import status.
fields.values: Filename, byte count, received time and import outcome.
fields.rules: Read-only. Received does not mean imported; processing may still be pending.

actions.name: Load results file / Choose file
actions.does: Selects an instrument and opens the operating-system file picker.
actions.availableWhen: Analysis authority and an approved file template are available.
actions.result: Stores a receipt of original bytes and schedules processing; does not change or move the original file.

actions.name: Open import attempt / Open the earlier import attempt
actions.does: Opens the new processing result or the original attempt for duplicate bytes.
actions.availableWhen: The corresponding attempt has been processed and found.
actions.result: Opens the latest processing attempt for the exact received or duplicate receipt, even when the receipt is outside recent list pages. Shows counts, file provenance and quarantine.

actions.name: Open import row
actions.result: Opens details with Previous and Next in list order.

actions.name: Cancel / Close
actions.does: Closes the file selection or receipt dialog.
actions.result: Cancelling the system picker loads nothing; closing an already-received receipt does not undo processing.

actions.name: Load older imports
actions.does: Loads the next page while preserving the selected filter and loaded rows.
actions.result: Appends records and updates the loaded count. Refresh rereads the current pages after other work changes the queue.

restrictions: Identical bytes received again from the same instrument are deduplicated. To reprocess after a reviewed template change, use Retry import on the existing receipt.
Files larger than 20 MiB are not read or imported; a receipt records the arrival. Export a supported smaller file.
The file receipt preserves transport evidence. Technical review and report release remain separate.
workflow: Choose the actual exporting instrument before selecting a file.
Wait for its processing outcome and open the import attempt.
Reconcile all counts, including QC, duplicates, set-aside and retained measurements.

troubleshooting.recovery: An authorized configuration reviewer must approve that result-file instrument’s template in Bench setup.
Open the earlier attempt. Use Retry import there after correcting a documented cause; selecting the identical file again does not reprocess it.

troubleshooting.problem: The file is received but no attempt is displayed.
troubleshooting.recovery: Keep the application running and check Result imports. If processing remains absent, inspect operational work and the instrument receipt; do not assume results were applied.

troubleshooting.problem: An older record is outside the displayed rows
troubleshooting.recovery: Use Load older imports until the needed record appears. Check filters and Refresh after concurrent changes; do not recreate the work to make it visible.

pages.title: Import attempt
pages.purpose: Reconcile one processing attempt, investigate quarantined rows and retry a corrected source receipt.
pages.access: Requires result-review authority. Opening details containing sample labels and values is audited.

fields.name: Attempt / Processed / Outcome
fields.meaning: Identifies the processing event and broad result.
fields.values: Attempt number, recorded processing time and Processed, Processed, some rows quarantined or Quarantined.
fields.rules: Read-only; supplied by the current record.

fields.name: Message failure / File failure
fields.meaning: Explains why no rows could be processed at file/message level.
fields.values: None or a reason such as malformed message, no approved source, sender mismatch, unreadable encoding, header mismatch or file limits.
fields.rules: Read-only; supplied by the current record.

fields.name: Rows / New results / Duplicates / Reprocessed / QC rows / Quarantined
fields.meaning: Accounts for rows processed by category.
fields.values: Nonnegative counts.
fields.rules: Read-only; duplicate does not create a second result. Reprocessing may create a new result revision.

fields.name: Not results / Set aside / Measured, not ordered (kept)
fields.meaning: Accounts for file rows outside ordinary result insertion.
fields.values: Counts of named nonresults, listed exclusions and measurements retained outside ordered scope.
fields.rules: Read-only; retained measurements are not automatically reported or billable ordered work.

fields.name: Origin / File name / Size / SHA-256 / Template
fields.meaning: Identifies the preserved file and the source version that read it.
fields.values: Manual loader or watched folder, filename, byte length, digest or Not computed, source software/version or no approved template.
fields.rules: Read-only; supplied by the current record.

fields.name: Tabs
fields.meaning: Separates rows requiring a decision from recorded exclusions.
fields.values: Quarantined and Set aside, each with a count.
fields.rules: File attempts only. Analyzer-message attempts show quarantine directly.

fields.name: Quarantined: Record / Sample label / Test code / Value as received
fields.meaning: Identifies the exact source evidence held back.
fields.values: Row reference, source label/code, original value and units, or Not reported.
fields.rules: Read-only. Investigate identity before attempting any resolution.

fields.name: Why quarantined
fields.meaning: Explains the row-level refusal.
fields.values: Unknown or ambiguous sample, closed run, unknown analyte, outside ordered scope, incompatible unit, unreadable value, output-scale mismatch, conflicting duplicate, unsupported/mismatched dilution, failed execution, malformed row or sample-role mismatch.
fields.rules: Read-only; supplied by the current record.

fields.name: Quarantine: State
fields.meaning: Tracks the row’s decision history.
fields.values: Needs a decision, Accepted as reprocessing, Rejected, Replaced by a retry.
fields.rules: Read-only; only open rows offer decisions.

fields.name: Set aside: Record / Sample label / Analyte as written / Value as received / Sample type / Why set aside
fields.meaning: Explains file rows that do not require a quarantine decision.
fields.values: Source text; calibrator/blank not on a run, or measured-but-not-ordered data that failed checks.
fields.rules: Read-only; this tab has no accept/reject controls.

fields.name: Retry import / Accept as reprocessing / Reject row: Reason
fields.meaning: Records why processing or a row decision is justified.
fields.values: Free text.
fields.rules: Required, trimmed 1–1,000 characters; preserved in the audit history.

actions.name: Retry import
actions.does: Processes the original complete receipt again after a reasoned request.
actions.availableWhen: Result-review authority and a complete stored receipt.
actions.result: Queues a new attempt; earlier open quarantine outcomes are superseded by the retry’s outcome. Review the new attempt.

actions.name: Open quarantined row
actions.does: Shows the full received evidence and refusal reason.
actions.result: Opens a panel with Previous, Next and Close.

actions.name: Accept as reprocessing / Accept row
actions.does: Applies a conflicting duplicate as reprocessed evidence.
actions.availableWhen: The row is open, specifically a conflicting duplicate, and all current checks pass.
actions.result: Creates a new result revision; current review/release requirements still apply.

actions.name: Reject row
actions.does: Declines to import the quarantined evidence.
actions.availableWhen: An open row and result-review authority.
actions.result: Keeps the row and reason, marked Rejected.

actions.name: Template
actions.does: Opens the exact file source used.
actions.availableWhen: The attempt has a known file-template registration.
actions.result: Shows its saved mappings and check controls.

actions.name: Previous / Next / Result imports
actions.does: Navigates the recorded list of attempts.
actions.availableWhen: Adjacent records exist when opened from a list.
actions.result: Changes the viewed attempt without applying a decision.

actions.name: Cancel
actions.does: Closes an unsubmitted retry or row decision.

actions.name: Refresh
actions.does: Reloads current evidence, state and revision for this record.
actions.result: Shows changes made by another workflow. Inspect refreshed facts before repeating any stale submission.

restrictions: Acceptance is not a general bypass for quarantine: only conflicting duplicates offer Accept as reprocessing.
A retry processes original received bytes with applicable current configuration; fix and approve the cause before retrying.
The file reader allows 50,000 rows, 512 columns and 4 KiB per field. Header matching is limited to the first 50 lines.
A successfully received message is separate from a successfully processed result.
workflow: Read the overall failure and reconcile all outcome counts.
For each quarantined row, compare the original label, analyte, value and units with the responsible run and approved source.
Correct configuration or workflow causes through their owning screens; record justified conflicting-row decisions or retry the receipt.
Open the resulting attempt and verify the outcome rather than relying on the queued-retry confirmation.

troubleshooting.problem: Header, unit or sample role does not match.
troubleshooting.recovery: Review the actual export and approved template/method/run role. Correct the source or register and approve a reviewed template; do not reinterpret data to force a pass.

troubleshooting.problem: More than one sample matches the label.
troubleshooting.recovery: Investigate the active run placements and material identity; resolve ambiguity before retrying.

troubleshooting.problem: The row is already resolved or replaced.
troubleshooting.recovery: Reload the attempt and inspect the latest retry/decision. Do not submit a decision against stale evidence.
